name: button
origin: shadcn/ui, style: aria-nova (base: react-aria-components). No asChild — use LinkButton for a link styled as a button, and isDisabled instead of disabled.
description: Displays a button, or a component that looks like one, in four variants (solid, soft, outline, ghost) × seven tones and a set of sizes. Also exports LinkButton (react-aria-components' Link, same variants and tones) for link-as-button use cases.
